messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Teams struggle with supplier integrations that grow more complex over time and risk breaking existing reporting systems. This undermines confidence in data accuracy and delays critical workflows.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4136",
   "similarity": 0.037,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is updating its supplier address fields to support international formats and improve data validation, ensuring accurate claim processing across global regions.\", \"id\": 4136, \"name\": \"Supplier address fields\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4138",
   "similarity": 0.036,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Configure global settings for your organisation within Keelwater, including default claim categories, notification preferences, and user permissions to ensure consistent workflows across teams.\", \"id\": 4138, \"name\": \"Organisation settings\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4130",
   "similarity": 0.034,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now provides a clearer, more detailed payment history view, helping users track transactions, refunds, and adjustments with improved timestamps and categorization for faster reconciliation.\", \"id\": 4130, \"name\": \"Payment history improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4129",
   "similarity": 0.034,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.\", \"id\": 4129, \"name\": \"Supplier contact details\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4134",
   "similarity": 0.033,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is enhancing its task list interface to improve user efficiency, allowing for better prioritization, drag-and-drop reordering, and real-time status updates—all designed to streamline claims processing workflows.\", \"id\": 4134, \"name\": \"Task list improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked whether the problem—increasingly complex supplier integrations risking breakage of existing reporting systems, undermining data confidence and delaying workflows—is solved by a shipped story or covered by a roadmap item. The most similar items (#4136 Supplier address fields, #4129 Supplier contact details) address narrow supplier data fields rather than integration complexity or reporting-system stability; #4129 is completed but only covers automatic contact detail syncing, not the core problem. The other stories (payment history, organisation settings, task lists) are unrelated. No evidence covers integration complexity breaking reporting systems.", "verdict": "pass"}
